$comment: Project-scope .mcp.json: read-only document-index servers (the pattern of second-brain/01 §7 and shared/12 §7; any implementation that exposes count/search/show/similar/stats as read-only tools). <document-index-module> is the project's own server module; <DOCUMENT_INDEX_DB> is the env var it reads the index path from. DB paths are absolute; the server opens them mode=ro. Register one server per audience when sessions differ in what they may see: a second entry with a different database is a different scope.
